scope: mobile SVG label legibility and component-scoped dark preset text; numeric model, state, controls, registry, lesson, course, and shared UI untouched

issues_fixed.fix: Added a dedicated 360-by-278 mobile SVG. Its 15-16 unit text renders at 11.58-12.36 CSS px in the measured 278 px slot; the title and alternate-phase cue use separate lines, and the plot is shifted down to prevent collisions.
Applied a component-scoped descendant text-ink utility to the existing PresetGroup buttons, covering active/inactive scenario and phase buttons without changing the shared Button primitive.

numeric_harness.method: Independent plain-JavaScript direct DFT; component helpers not imported.

mobile_inspection.method: Initial component server-rendered with freshly compiled app/globals.css, then measured and screenshotted in headless Chrome.
mobile_inspection.visual_result: PASS: all chart labels and both title lines are legible without overlap; all preset labels are plainly visible in active and inactive states in both themes.
